title: Code Ownership Inference

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Code Ownership Inference": Infer likely owners for unowned code and services from contribution history, on-call data and reviews so ownership files are complete, for team leads to confirm. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Individual owners.
